title: Cache-to-Cache: Direct Semantic Communication Between LLMs (2025)
summary: This paper proposes a novel 'Cache-to-Cache' paradigm enabling direct semantic communication between Large Language Models without converting to natural language. The approach aims to eliminate semantic loss inherent in traditional encode-decode communication by sharing cached knowledge representations directly between LLMs.
problem_solved: Eliminates the efficiency loss and semantic degradation that occurs when LLMs must encode thoughts into natural language for communication with other models.
why_valuable: This work opens a new research direction for native semantic exchange between AI systems, potentially revolutionizing how distributed AI agents collaborate and communicate.
